title: CUDA Streams：傳輸與計算流水線
subcategoryTitle: 異質程式、數值核心與介面
summary: 畫四塊的三泳道時間線，每塊D2H都在自己核計算後，重用緩衝須等消費完成；33/25正確且沒有跨塊依賴違反，合成重疊前提逐項列出。
summaryEn: Draw four chunks across three lanes; each D2H follows its own kernel, and buffer reuse waits for consumption. Verify 33/25 with no dependency violation and explicit synthetic overlap assumptions.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

options: 預期重疊消失可能使用同步拷貝，資料損壞可能過早重用緩衝；對照事件時間線與每塊序號，先查是否重疊，再查同一緩衝覆寫時間。
增加chunk數會引入啟動成本，不能把理想流水式無限外推；33/25正確且沒有跨塊依賴違反，合成重疊前提逐項列出。
非同步串流可表達傳輸與計算；重疊仍依賴裝置引擎、緩衝與資料相依。
optionsEn: Missing overlap may use synchronous copies; corrupted data may reuse buffers too early. Compare event timelines/chunk IDs, checking overlap before buffer overwrite times.
More chunks introduce launch cost, so ideal pipeline scaling cannot be extrapolated indefinitely. Verify 33/25 with no dependency violation and explicit synthetic overlap assumptions.
Asynchronous streams express transfers/computation; overlap still depends on engines, buffers and dependencies.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「案例與來源邊界」。非同步串流可表達傳輸與計算；重疊仍依賴裝置引擎、緩衝與資料相依。 與本階段判準一起判讀：第一塊12ms，後三塊各7ms得到33；與不重疊48ms作對照；對介面圖逐一標明輸入、輸出、單位與來源；實際架構敘述和合成量測必須分欄。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies case and source boundary. Asynchronous streams express transfers/computation; overlap still depends on engines, buffers and dependencies. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: First chunk 12 plus three intervals 7 gives 33, versus 48 without overlap. Label inputs, outputs, units and provenance; separate sourced architecture from synthetic observations.

steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. First chunk 12 plus three intervals 7 gives 33, versus 48 without overlap. Label inputs, outputs, units and provenance; separate sourced architecture from synthetic observations.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
steps.check: 第一塊12ms，後三塊各7ms得到33；與不重疊48ms作對照；對介面圖逐一標明輸入、輸出、單位與來源；實際架構敘述和合成量測必須分欄。
steps.checkEn: First chunk 12 plus three intervals 7 gives 33, versus 48 without overlap. Label inputs, outputs, units and provenance; separate sourced architecture from synthetic observations.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: 非同步串流可表達傳輸與計算；重疊仍依賴裝置引擎、緩衝與資料相依。
knowledge.textEn: Asynchronous streams express transfers/computation; overlap still depends on engines, buffers and dependencies.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 畫四塊的三泳道時間線，每塊D2H都在自己核計算後，重用緩衝須等消費完成；33/25正確且沒有跨塊依賴違反，合成重疊前提逐項列出。
knowledge.textEn: Draw four chunks across three lanes; each D2H follows its own kernel, and buffer reuse waits for consumption. Verify 33/25 with no dependency violation and explicit synthetic overlap assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 理想三階段每塊a,b,c，k塊流水時間a+b+c+(k−1)max(a,b,c)，假設引擎獨立且緩衝足夠。
knowledge.textEn: Ideal three-stage pipeline time is a+b+c+(k−1)max(a, b, c), assuming independent engines and sufficient buffers.
